items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I didn't have no trouble with the men's because the men know what they have to do they had a bit of trouble with them they had all good men's too Benny Turner Sidney Flusio Robert Davis Paul and Howard and myself had six pieces
